title: Biome Overrides
description: The hand-written exceptions in the grid-cell biome classification described in tools/gazetteer/biome.py -- the same suppression-file pattern data/map/groundtruth-overrides.json already uses for buildings, applied to cells. Real GeoPackage data and each promoted district's own declared `kind` decide a cell's biome automatically; this file is for the specific cells neither gets right (a hidden bunker entrance under what reads as open ground, a cell a district's tessellation edge clips awkwardly), and it always wins outright over both. Consumed by tools/gazetteer/biome.py's load_overrides/save_overrides.

ref.description: A grid reference, e.g. 'C4·11' (middle dot, not a period) -- see tools/gazetteer/core/grid.py's cell_to_ref and SEPARATOR.

biome.description: Must match one of core/biome.py's own BIOMES exactly -- kept as a literal enum here rather than generated so a schema-only reader (no Python import) still knows the real taxonomy.

note.description: Why this cell needed a hand override, for whoever reads this file next.
